title: The Witness Window
subtitle: TOREN: Preserve evidence without turning its owner into a target.
offer: At Fonogom in Galaxy 4, after one ordinary trade. No imported score gate or source campaign prerequisite. The reference loan needs one tonne of free hold.
story: A shift worker witnessed an avoidable docking injury, but an arbitration system will erase the recording when its routine privacy window expires. The worker wants protection without surrendering control of testimony. The commander verifies consented copies, establishes a safe hearing and chooses an independently witnessed sealed archive or a public anonymised finding.
playerBriefing: TOREN: Preserve evidence without turning its owner into a target.
completionBenefit: The selected verified settlement persists in local records. No free hull, unrelated legal reset or artificial combat kills. A permanent clue for The Unwritten Route: The frame nobody recorded.
branchPolicy: Store the selected plan-a or plan-b identity once, separately from its authored display label. Apply only that branch at apply-settlement; both distinct physical and receiving proofs are required. Both legitimate endings share one final reward and one source clue.
interactionNotes: Use the existing mission log, targeting, scan, contextual Confirm and Esc. Preview all obligations before accepting; cancellation changes nothing.
Keep the reference instrument in reserved custody through the field work, witness reception and selected settlement. Returning it is part of the independent terminal audit.

Preserve actual crew and entity identities. Culling is not death or arrival. A lost unnamed tender may be replaced with a new consenting crew after real rescue handling; never resurrect a named casualty. A lost reference invalidates its old serial before a real replacement loan.

All objectives are space flight or space-station handoffs. Stations remain protected from single-ship weapons. No source world overrides, equipment budgets, hidden reputation grind or external storyline progress is required.
authoredSource: Original L337 narrative, objectives, dialogs, locations and rewards
rewardPolicy: Pay credits once, atomically with the terminal receipt. Delay optional equipment fitting if incompatible; offer it again without duplicating payment. Never award kill points for non-kills or clear unrelated legal status. Commit the clue and terminal reward receipt atomically; a pending optional fitting does not delay the clue.
identityPolicy: Match locations by galaxy/system identity, not coordinates or displayed spelling. Match entities by mission instance and target ID, never merely ship type.
persistencePolicy: Every campaign starts unaccepted with its current identity and zero progress. Persist current-format stage evidence, choices, mission-item custody, reward and clue receipts. Resume these records on load; replayed events cannot duplicate rewards. No previous campaign or save format is imported.
